rule: receiver-face landing: ring on the sender's forwarded region clock ck_s (one ck_s input per landed face port group = per (src instance, dst instance) pair), read on the receiver root; <=32 b -> LAND8 D8 hop-0, >32 b -> ceil(bits/258) narrow pairs (514 b -> 257 pair); +3 edges; static, no backpressure

qfd_dv_slice2_e.extra_face_pins_basis: per landed face group: ck_s (sender forwarded region clock) + en_s (sender released reset, the LAND8 en / narrow-writer rsi); data pins unchanged (the bus pins already exist); LAND8 K straps k0..k3 are tied inside the master by the face generator from the die's L

qfd_dv_slice2_w.extra_face_pins_basis: per landed face group: ck_s (sender forwarded region clock) + en_s (sender released reset, the LAND8 en / narrow-writer rsi); data pins unchanged (the bus pins already exist); LAND8 K straps k0..k3 are tied inside the master by the face generator from the die's L

price.note: one pass along the chain (every landed slice edge serial once); the list's worst case dv_chain_hops 11 (+33/layer) is 1 more (likely E0<->E1, today one shared root pll_r95, not landed; +3 if it splits); both are inside the list's 45 cycles/layer, not additional to it
